title: Speech and voice
learning_outcomes: Explain voice mechanics in the context of speech and voice.
Compare and distinguish phrasing in the context of speech and voice.
Apply pace and emphasis in the context of speech and voice.
Evaluate and justify decisions about audience adaptation in the context of speech and voice.

lessons.title: Voice mechanics
lessons.outcome: Explain voice mechanics in the context of speech and voice.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving voice mechanics; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to recorded explanation or transcript.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain voice mechanics from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of voice mechanics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Phrasing
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish phrasing in the context of speech and voice.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving phrasing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to recorded explanation or transcript.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain phrasing from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of phrasing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Pace and emphasis
lessons.outcome: Apply pace and emphasis in the context of speech and voice.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving pace and emphasis; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to recorded explanation or transcript.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain pace and emphasis from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of pace and emphasis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Audience adaptation
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about audience adaptation in the context of speech and voice.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving audience adaptation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to recorded explanation or transcript.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain audience adaptation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of audience adaptation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of voice mechanics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of phrasing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of pace and emphasis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of audience adaptation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
